description: This file contains utility functions for handling Windows file paths, including detecting drive prefixes, skipping prefixes, extracting components, and comparing paths in a case-insensitive manner within a Windows environment.

methods.name: int win32_has_dos_drive_prefix(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the provided path starts with a DOS drive prefix, like 'C:' or virtual drive.

methods.name: int win32_skip_dos_drive_prefix(char ** path)
methods.description: Advances the path pointer past the DOS drive prefix if present.

methods.name: int win32_offset_1st_component(const char * path)
methods.description: Returns the offset to the first component in a Windows path, handling UNC paths and drive prefixes.

methods.name: int win32_fspathncmp(const char * a,const char * b,size_t count)
methods.description: Compares two filesystem paths in a case-insensitive manner up to a specified length.

methods.name: int win32_fspathcmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Compares two filesystem paths in a case-insensitive manner until the end of both strings.

ctags.name: win32_fspathncmp
ctags.pattern: /^int win32_fspathncmp(const char *a, const char *b, size_t count)$/
